_about: Structural model settings the user can change on the VVL tab (reasoning, output length, image detail), per model family.
Families match the ids in models_local.yaml. Sampling values (temperature etc.) are NOT user settings: they are the model card defaults, recorded here so the engine can use them.
Most user controls have two simple options; reasoning strength offers a family's own levels. 'literal' says exactly what is sent for each option, so the GUI can show it.
Checked on 2026-11-19 against the chat template inside each GGUF file, the model cards on Hugging Face, and llama.cpp b12359 (per-request chat_template_kwargs rendered with /apply-template).

reasoning.label: Reasoning
reasoning._note: Per request, so OCR and parsing can differ while the same model stays loaded. Reasoning tokens count toward the output token limit.

strength.label: Reasoning strength
strength._note: Only for families whose reasoning lists 'levels'. Sent while reasoning is on, in place of '{strength}' in reasoning.literal.on. A family with can_turn_off false still reasons when reasoning is off (at its lowest level), so it gets the reasoning-on output token limits.

output_length.label: Output length
output_length.needs_engine_restart: only when the engine's context window must grow (see engine_rules.context)

image_detail.label: Image detail
image_detail._note: Engine start options (--image-min-tokens / --image-max-tokens). Parsing sends no image, so it only applies to OCR.

output_length_tokens._note: max_tokens sent per request. With reasoning on, the limit must also hold the thinking, so it is larger. Families may override.

image_detail_tokens._note: Visual tokens per image for models with dynamic resolution (Qwen-style vision). llama.cpp warns that Qwen-VL needs at least 1024.

engine_rules.context: Per model, minimum 8,192 tokens, maximum the model's own context_length (read from its GGUF header). Automatic = the smallest size that holds the chosen settings (image tokens + ~400 prompt tokens + OCR max_tokens; ~2,000 parse-prompt tokens + transcription + parse max_tokens), or, when reasoning is on for a step that uses the model, the largest that fits in the free graphics memory with one request slot. A size chosen on the VVL tab (generation.context) wins; then a size set on the Engine tab for all models. Changing it restarts that model's engine at the next request (vvl/llama/pool.py).
engine_rules.reasoning_flag: Sent per request (chat_template_kwargs, or a prompt suffix for MiMo-VL), on and off alike, so OCR and parsing can differ while one engine serves both. No server-wide --reasoning flag is used.
engine_rules.reasoning_output: llama-server returns thinking separately in message.reasoning_content; only message.content is used as the OCR text or the JSON record.
engine_rules.sampling: Model card defaults below are sent as-is with every request; card names are translated to llama-server's (repetition_penalty -> repeat_penalty).

qwen3-vl.label: Qwen3-VL

reasoning._note: The Instruct builds have no thinking mode (their chat template has no switch). Qwen publishes separate -Thinking checkpoints.

qwen3-vl.card_output_length: 16,384 tokens recommended for vision tasks (README out_seq_length)

qwen3-6.label: Qwen3.6

reasoning._note: Thinks by default. Template also has preserve_thinking (multi-turn only; not used).

qwen3-6.card_output_length: 32,768 tokens for most queries; 81,920 for very hard problems

qwen3-5.label: Qwen3.5

reasoning._note: Same switch as Qwen3.6 (from the model card; the GGUF template was not read because the download was still running).

sampling_defaults.source: Qwen/Qwen3.5-122B-A10B README (Best Practices); generation_config.json says temperature 0.6

qwen3-5.card_output_length: 32,768 tokens for most queries; 81,920 for very hard problems

reasoning._note: The template's own default is off, but llama-server (reasoning 'auto') turns it on when nothing is sent, so the switch must always be sent explicitly. On adds <|think|> to the system turn.

image_detail._note: Not verified: Gemma 4 uses fixed visual token budgets (Will's experiments used 1,120); whether this llama.cpp build honors --image-max-tokens for gemma4v is untested.

reasoning._note: There is no 'none' level: off means the lowest strength (low), and the model still reasons, so it gets the reasoning-on output token limits. On sends the chosen strength (levels from the model card; the template writes 'Reasoning strength: <level>.' into the system turn, default high). The server-wide --reasoning off flag does NOT change it.

image_detail._note: Card: up to 4,096 visual tokens per image. Whether this llama.cpp build honors --image-max-tokens for Muse is untested.

mimo.label: MiMo
mimo._note: Two different models share this family; settings are per build.

off._where: end of the last user message, after the image

reasoning._note: The chat template has no switch; the model card says to end the user message with /no_think. The server-wide --reasoning off flag does NOT change it, so this model currently thinks during OCR and parsing.
Verified with /apply-template: enable_thinking false adds an empty <think></think> block.

The chat template has only enable_thinking (it writes 'detailed thinking on/off'). 'low' adds a 512-token reasoning budget through llama-server; 'high' leaves reasoning unlimited. Read from the GGUF header on 2026-11-20; the budget field name is taken from the b12359 binary and not yet verified.

The chat template has enable_thinking and medium_effort (it appends '{reasoning effort: efficient}' to the last user turn). 'low' sends medium_effort true; 'high' is full reasoning. Read from the GGUF header on 2026-11-20.
